Steps to Reproduce:

1. Author an extension using VSCode as a dev dependency. Our package.json looks like this
```
    "devDependencies": {
        "@types/glob": "^7.1.1",
        "@types/jquery": "^3.3.35",
        "@types/markdown-it": "^10.0.0",

        "mocha": "^7.1.1",
        "tslint-microsoft-contrib": "^6.0.0",
        "tslint-no-unused-expression-chai": "^0.1.4",
        "typescript": "^3.8.3",
        "vscode": "^1.1.36",
        "vscode-test": "^1.3.0",
        "tslint": "^6.1.1"
    },
```
These are all the latest packages. When running npm audit:

                       === npm audit security report ===
                                 Manual Review
             Some vulnerabilities require your attention to resolve
          Visit https://go.npm.me/audit-guide for additional guidance
